TypeTaxonScript: sugarifying and enhancing data structures in biological systematics and biodiversity research
text:
TypeTaxonScript is a framework for managing taxonomic data collaboratively. It allows users to create, edit, and share taxonomic information in a structured format.
https://doi.org/10.1093/biomethods/bpae017
It is better read in PDF format, which can be downloaded from the link below.
https://academic.oup.com/biomethods/article-pdf/9/1/bpae017/57136701/bpae017.pdf

title: Advances in systematics of Mimosa (Fabaceae): phylogeny and biogeography of the Petiolovariabilis clade
text:
This study presents a comprehensive analysis of the phylogeny and biogeography of the Petiolovariabilis clade within the genus Mimosa (Fabaceae). The authors used molecular data to reconstruct the evolutionary history of this group and to infer its biogeographic patterns.
https://doi.org/10.1093/sysbio/syaa096

title: Trichomes in Mimosa (Leguminosae): Towards a characterization and a terminology standardization
text:
This study presents a comprehensive analysis of the trichome characteristics in Mimosa (Leguminosae). The authors aimed to characterize and standardize the terminology used to describe trichomes in this genus.
https://doi.org/10.1016/j.flora.2020.151702
